artifacts.name: canonical Node and Linux runtime container

restrictions: Project-authored calibration control only; not renderer PDF evidence
Valid control uses PDF vectors only and contains no image XObject
Later renderer candidates must pass this profile without calibration overlays

color.alpha: getImageData straight alpha; zero RGB below zero alpha
color.space: Skia canvas output normalized to straight-alpha sRGB RGBA8

dimensions.expected_output: canvas of exactly the caller-supplied width and height; 200x120 for qualification
dimensions.page_selection: exactly one page with rotation 0 and UserUnit 1
dimensions.rounding: none; the 96/72 viewport is drawn with the page origin at the canvas origin and cropped to the canvas, canvas pixels the page does not cover stay transparent; admitted when each 96 DPI page dimension is within one pixel of the canvas, so an integral page requires exact equality

errors.dimensions: multi-page, rotated, UserUnit, and canvases a pixel or more off the page's 96 DPI size are rejected, naming the page size and the supplied size
errors.render: load, operator-list, and render failures are fatal

state.process: fresh Node process and PDF worker per render
state.sharing: no worker, document, canvas, font, cache, clock, or viewer state shared between roles
